signal_test.mbt.name: propagation: source -> computed -> effect, and the effect runs once
laziness: nothing recomputes until someone reads or flushes
diamond: the sink is consistent and evaluated once
cut-off: an unchanged intermediate value stops the wave
flush: many writes collapse into one effect run and one compute
effects run in level order, deterministically
write-back from an effect converges and is reported
an oscillating write-back hits the pass cap and reports overflow
deep chain: 2000 levels propagate without stack trouble
fan-out: 500 effects all see the new value once
validate: healthy graph reports nothing, broken edges are caught
build-time errors: self dependency, forward edge, duplicate edge, readonly write
two-way binding: user writes mirror, model writes mirror, conflicts respect the user
two-way binding: mirrors drive downstream nodes once, not twice
generic: a Graph of a struct value type works the same way
interleaved sources and computed nodes keep exact edges and values

signal_bench_test.mbt.name: bench narrow write: set + flush on a 1000-node chain
bench cut-off: a write that changes nothing downstream
